task:
Create a PriorityClass and use it in a Pod.

Task 1 — Create a PriorityClass named 'high-priority' with:
  - value: 1000000
  - globalDefault: false
  - description: "This priority class is for critical workloads"

Task 2 — Create a Pod named 'critical-pod' in namespace 'default' using:
  - Image: nginx:1.21
  - priorityClassName: high-priority

Task 3 — Verify the pod uses the correct priority:
  kubectl get pod critical-pod -o jsonpath='{.spec.priorityClassName}'
  # Expected: high-priority

  kubectl get pod critical-pod -o jsonpath='{.spec.priority}'
  # Expected: 1000000
hints: kubectl get priorityclass  shows all classes including built-in system ones
detailed_hints: PriorityClass YAML: apiVersion: scheduling.k8s.io/v1, kind: PriorityClass, metadata: {name: high-priority}, value: 1000000, globalDefault: false, description: '...'
Pod YAML: add priorityClassName: high-priority under spec:

validators.command: kubectl get pod critical-pod -n default -o jsonpath='{.status.phase}'
kubectl get pod critical-pod -n default -o jsonpath='{.spec.priorityClassName}'
kubectl get pod critical-pod -n default -o jsonpath='{.spec.priority}'
